# PakaiNow.AI

> ASEAN's first home-grown generative AI-powered fashion visualisation platform, built in Malaysia. Sovereign AI infrastructure, enterprise ready.

PakaiNow.AI helps fashion and retail brands offer AI-powered virtual try-on and visualisation, and offers AI/GenAI development, cloud engineering, UI/UX design, and Claude AI managed services for enterprises in ASEAN.
